// what this config is for: The FLOOR of the react peer range. peerDependencies says this package supports "^18.3.0 || ^19.0.0"; devDependencies can only install one of them, so without this config that range is an aspiration — and the half that goes unchecked is React 18, which is exactly what Expo/React Native pins. `npm run typecheck` runs both.
// how it works: @types/react-18 is an npm alias (see package.json devDependencies) for @types/react@~18.3.0, installed alongside the 19 line. Redirecting the two module specifiers TypeScript resolves for JSX — "react" and the "react/jsx-runtime" that jsx: react-jsx emits — compiles the whole package against the older types with no second install and no version juggling.
